segments.name: Applied Workflow Automation
segments.description: Provides AI-enabled workflow services for clients' systems, including payment processing, data capture and distribution, for banks, payers, utilities and government.
segments.evidence: The Applied Workflow Automation segment includes the Company's Bills & Payments, healthcare industry solutions, on-site enterprise solutions, integrated communications and enterprise legal management business units which serve leading banks, payers and providers, utilities as well as federal, regional and local government entities.

segments.name: Technology
products: industry specific platforms for the banking and healthcare industries
segments.description: Sells recurring and perpetual software licenses, maintenance, professional services and hardware, plus industry platforms for banking and healthcare.
segments.evidence: The Company also offers industry specific platforms for the banking and healthcare industries.

revenueModel.text: Clients pay transaction-based fees for volumes processed, fixed management fees, and software licenses, maintenance and professional services.
revenueModel.evidence: We generate revenue through transaction-based processing fees, fixed-fee managed services, and recurring software licenses and maintenance, along with professional services for system configuration and integration.

changes.text: In 2025 the Company reevaluated its segment reporting, resulting in two businesses: Applied Workflow Automation and Technology.
changes.evidence: As part of Business Combination, the Company reevaluated its segment reporting, resulting in the presentation of two businesses: Applied Workflow Automation and Technology.
